title: Fábio Faria and the Revealed Messages Scandal
seoTitle: Fábio Faria and the Revealed Messages Scandal
subtitle: Cell Phone Messages Link Former Minister to Meetings at Daniel Vorcaro's Mansion
excerpt: Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's cell phone show Fábio Faria organizing meetings with authorities at the Brasília mansion, fueling rumors of betrayal and other.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Message leaks obtained by the Federal Police from businessman Daniel Vorcaro's cell phone place former Communications Minister Fábio Faria at the center of a series of meetings that took place at the banker's mansion in Brasília. The content of the conversations fuels suspicions circulating on social media and in the press about possible agreements and invitations to authorities.

What the Messages Reveal About Meetings at the Mansion

In one of the collected dialogues, Fábio Faria confirms the presence of Davi Alcolumbre, President of the Senate, and Senator Pacheco, future minister of the Federal Court of Accounts, at a meeting scheduled at Vorcaro's residence. The same message mentions the participation of Supreme Federal Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes and STF Justice Dias Toffoli.

Reference to International Guests

Faria also comments that “Davi is crazy asking if the Swiss women are coming,” and Vorcaro replies that the Swiss women will come, although it is not clear who these people would be.

Link to Other Federal Police Investigations

The Federal Police's Compliance Zero report indicates that the mansion, purchased in June 2024 for 36 million reais, served as a venue for lavish dinners and parties, hosting authorities such as Alexandre de Moraes. The property was improperly made unavailable in March 2024 by a decision of Supreme Court Justice André Mendiça.

Context of Messages in the Vorcaro Case

The conversations emerged after the Federal Police recovered files from Vorcaro's cell phone. He was also named as an intermediary for monthly payments of 3.6 million reais to lawyer Viviane Barci, Moraes' wife. Furthermore, the investigation mentions a payment of 30 million dollars to Senator Davi Alcolumbre, recorded in a plea bargain proposal.

Repercussion for Patrícia Abravanel

The same leak brought to light rumors of alleged betrayal involving Patrícia Abravanel's husband, former minister Fábio Faria. In response, the presenter deactivated comments on her official Instagram profile, without issuing a public statement on the content of the documents.

With information from Terra, CartaCapital, VEJA.
